name: Speedlink
summary: Wollongong dialup ISP ('56k digital access and Fiber Optic links to the Internet'); access plans, hosting/domains, modem sales and Half-Life game servers; defunct.

events.details: Dialup ISP for the Wollongong area (ph. 02 4284 7766); member usage stats, access plans and customer home pages.

refs.label: Speedlink (Wayback Apr 1999) — 'an Internet Service Provider providing access to Wollongong area'

events.details: Defunct; speedlink.com.au no longer resolves (checked Aug 2026). Acquired by Chariot Limited in FY2003-04 (2004 Annual Report: 'Speedlink Internet (Wollongong, New South Wales)').
